description_evaluated: Keep Replit project work autonomous and Free Mode-first with bounded execution, checkpointed quota recovery, and quiet upgrade handling. Use when the user asks to maximize Free Mode, avoid repeated upgrade nudges, retry after a five-hour or weekly limit, preserve work across interruptions, or keep routine work moving without unnecessary approval pauses. Does not bypass quotas or human approval.
